summary.zh-CN: 通过 Shizuku 检查 Android 预装运营商组件，查看各空间状态与权限，并管理卸载、恢复及失败后的停用。
summary.en: Uses Shizuku to inspect Android carrier packages across user spaces and manage removal, restoration and disabling after failed uninstalls.

zh-CN: 检测已知运营商预装组件
查看各用户空间的安装状态和权限记录
评估影响后管理指定空间的组件状态
en: Inspect package states and permission records across user spaces
Manage selected package states after assessing their effects

reason.zh-CN: 该提交实现手动卸载失败后的停用选项、结果状态及恢复处理。已阅读设置与包操作差异，属于功能变更，未运行手机测试。
reason.en: Implements the disable fallback, result states and restoration handling for failed manual uninstalls. Settings and package-operation diffs were inspected; no device test was run.

supports.zh-CN: 官方用途、功能范围、入门和限制。
supports.en: Official purpose, feature scope, setup and limitations.

supports.zh-CN: 当前根许可证及适用范围。
supports.en: Current root license and its scope.

supports.zh-CN: 本次仓库身份、Star 和公开状态。
supports.en: Repository identity, Stars and public state at review time.

supports.zh-CN: MIT 为 OSI 批准的许可证；与根文件许可条款对照。
supports.en: MIT is OSI-approved; its permission terms were compared with the root file.

supports.zh-CN: 自动清理及停用兜底的默认值。
supports.en: Defaults for automatic cleanup and disable fallback.

supports.zh-CN: 按用户空间解析权限记录。
supports.en: Permission records parsed per user space.

supports.zh-CN: v1.3 停用兜底及 vivo 限制说明。
supports.en: v1.3 disable fallback and documented vivo limitations.

notes.zh-CN: Star 未达门槛。已核对 MIT 与近期功能提交；只做文档和源码复核，未操作设备。
notes.en: Below the Star threshold. MIT and recent functional activity were checked; documentation and source review only, with no device operations.
